subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Commence
solution:
The correct answer is 'Conclude'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• Let's take a look at the given word and the marked option:

 
 
• Commence: to begin something.(कुछ शुरू करने के लिए.)

 
 
• Example*:** *We will commence building work in August of next year.
 
 
 
• Conclude: to cause something to end, or to end.(किसी चीज़ को समाप्त करने या समाप्त करने का कारण बनना)
 
 
• Example:* *She concluded her remarks by thanking her supporters.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus from above, we can say that the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Arise: come into being; originate.(उठना)
 
• Begin: come into being or have its starting point at a certain time or place.(शुरू)
 
• Launch: start or set in motion (an activity or enterprise).(शुरू करना)
